notes:
## 0.4.9

- Themes match their designs more closely: Nord gets a two-pane History and a smooth chart, Terminal its command-style labels, and every theme shows shortcut keys and times the way it was designed.
- Acronyms stay together. "POV" no longer comes out as "Po V" (also works for words you add to your Dictionary).
- Faster on PCs without an NVIDIA graphics card, and a few small fixes in Settings and History.
